analysis_commit_note: Residual completion starts from the current codex/flow-node-mockup-parity candidate in a fresh isolated graph worktree. Existing P0-P8 code is the base; only disclosed residuals, certification enforcement, closeout, and integration are new work.

plan_sections.BASE: Reproduce the candidate's declared certification on an isolated copy of 47931eb and freeze the residual acceptance oracle before changing code. AC-BASE: The candidate's focused/full tests, browser walks, P8 selector artifact, known exceptions, environment, and Git identity are reproducible and every unexplained red blocks implementation.
plan_sections.P8-LOCAL: Make the local P8 artifact measure every declared selector or carry an explicit per-selector non-applicability ruling, including the run menu and normal-rendering selected state. AC-P8-LOCAL: Light, dark, and system fixtures provide per-selector non-vacuous measurements, direct run-menu coverage, and distinguishable selected-state carriers in normal and forced-colors rendering.
plan_sections.P8-CI: Make the browser-measured P8 contract a required post-merge gate rather than a local certification receipt that can silently regress. AC-P8-CI: Required-browser CI executes the complete measured state contract in light, dark, and system modes and fails on missing, stale, partial, inert-theme, below-floor, or non-color-carrier regressions.
plan_sections.RUN-DATA: Prove planned_documents, six-state progress, and the positive downstream cone note through the real server route and rendered card using a synthetic read-only upstream fixture. AC-RUN-DATA: A PHI-free immutable upstream fixture drives real route-to-card progress and positive cone behavior without response injection, fabricated success, or upstream writes.
plan_sections.JOIN: Integrate the three independent residual closures and prove their combined behavior on one candidate commit. AC-JOIN: The three lane commits are semantically joined and all focused UI, accessibility, responsive, network, topology, console, and UI-graph checks pass together.
plan_sections.CLOSE: Certify the joined candidate, close the source plan truthfully, and integrate the completed result back into codex/flow-node-mockup-parity. AC-CLOSE: All owned acceptance criteria and final gates pass on one commit, operator-owned exceptions remain explicit, the plan is archived only when complete, and the integration commit is read back from the base branch.
